draft_key_information_units.information: Revenue surged from SEK 1.06 million in 2024 to SEK 32.06 million in 2025, driven by major commercial agreements and customer acquisitions.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: The Group's revenue in 2025 amounted to SEK 32,058 thousand (SEK 1,061 thousand). The sharp increase in sales is a direct consequence of the invoicing of several major transactions taking place according to previously communicated plan.

draft_key_information_units.information: Operating profit improved to SEK -29.27 million (from SEK -51.78 million) with EBITDA turning positive at SEK 2.96 million; adjusted EBITDA margin reached approximately 32% after excluding one-off costs.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: The operating profit for the Group in 2025 amounted to -29,270 thousand SEK (-51,781 thousand SEK), where the EBITDA result was 2,957 thousand SEK (-28,229 thousand SEK). Adjusted for these, EBITDA amounted to approximately 13,195 thousand SEK, corresponding to an adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 32 percent of the Group's revenue.

draft_key_information_units.information: Key customer agreements included Win.Rocks AG (total SEK 21 million contract value), Sergel Kredittjänster for AI document interpretation, and strategic partnerships with Allgeier Inovar GmbH and TIM Solutions GmbH for distribution.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: During the year, the collaboration with Win.Rocks AG has grown to a total contract value of approximately SEK 21 million... During the year, an agreement was also signed with Sergel Kredittjänster... OODA AI has also established a growing customer base... developed its partner strategy through... Allgeier Inovar GmbH and TIM Solutions GmbH

draft_key_information_units.information: Group structure streamlined through mergers of EO Capital 2, EO Capital 3, EPLIK companies, and oodash Sweden AB into oodash Portfolio AB, with EO Capital 1 AB merged into OODA AI AB post-year.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: During the first half of the year, the companies EO Capital 2, EO Capital 3, EPLIK 202306 and EPLIK 202312 merged into oodash Portfolio AB... merger of oodash Sweden AB into oodash Portfolio AB... After the end of the financial year, on January 5, 2026, the merger of EO Capital 1 AB into OODA AI AB (publ) was registered.

draft_key_information_units.information: Equity decreased significantly from SEK 119.37 million to SEK 23.86 million due to impairments and financial item losses, offset partially by multiple capital raises totaling at least SEK 35 million during and after 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: The Group's equity at the end of 2025 amounted to 23,859 thousand SEK, compared to 119,371 thousand SEK at the end of 2024... During 2025, the Company was provided with capital through issues in January, March and August... after the end of the financial year, it was also decided to issue another cash issue of approximately SEK 10 million.

draft_key_information_units.information: Cash flow from operating activities was negative SEK 16.66 million for the year but turned positive at SEK 5.10 million in the second half of 2025, indicating operational improvement.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Cash flow from operating activities amounted to -16,662 thousand SEK... During the second half of 2025, the Group simultaneously reported a positive cash flow from operating activities of 5,098 thousand SEK

draft_key_information_units.information: Strategic shift from build-up to growth phase focusing on scaling platform usage, expanding distribution through partners and self-service, and developing next-generation AI infrastructure.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: OODA AI enters 2026 in a new phase... The focus is now clear: to scale the business and increase usage of our platform... Our priorities are clear: increase platform usage, expand distribution and continue developing the underlying infrastructure.

draft_key_information_units.information: Decentralized AI initiative progressed from concept to operational infrastructure with MVP and testnet validated, moving towards commercial deployment with tokenization creating new revenue streams.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: We have moved from concept to operational infrastructure with an MVP and testnet, where both technical functionality and economic flows are validated. The next step is to take this model towards commercial deployment. Tokenization is a central part of this, enabling the creation of an economic layer where computation, verification and incentives interact.

draft_key_information_units.information: Material post-reporting-period events include completion of EO Capital 1 AB merger on January 5, 2026, public launch of new website and platform in Q2 2026, and a March 31, 2026 cash issue of approximately SEK 10 million.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: On January 5, 2026, the merger of EO Capital 1 AB was registered... On March 16, 2026, a new website and platform were published and will be offered to the public in the second quarter of 2026... On March 31, 2026, the Company decided on a cash issue of approximately SEK 10 million

evaluation.selection_rationale: Selected units capture headline financial performance (D1-D2), major drivers and developments (D3, D7-D8), structural changes (D4), liquidity/financing position (D5), operational cash flow trend (D6, medium importance), and material post-year events (D9). Excluded routine boilerplate (governance, remuneration, risk lists, accounting policies). Units are mutually independent and material to understanding core financial and strategic position. Total units: 9 (within 6-10 target).
